4) Kickoff: propose 60–90 minute kickoff week of Aug 5; customer prefers mornings PT.
5) Risks: customer has strict change windows (no changes to production between 02:00–07:00 PT Mon–Fri).

Notes: I spoke with Elaine this morning — they want a practical 30-day activation plan (minimum viable model + acceptance criteria) and a separate migration plan for protected workloads.

Please reply with owner assignment and any blockers.
